facts.business: Universal Office Automation Limited is a listed company with no active business operations during the year under review, as management is exploring new business opportunities.

auditor.name: V NAGARAJAN & Co, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has significant accumulated losses, incurred losses of Rs. 1.16 lakhs in current year and Rs 8.59 lakhs in previous year, net worth fully eroded, current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 178.84 lakhs as at March 31, 2026. Financial statements prepared on going concern basis due to financial support from Promoter Group.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to fully eroded net worth and accumulated losses
Current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 178.84 lakhs
Dependence on promoter group financial support to meet obligations
facts.related_party_note: No contracts/transactions with related parties during the financial year that could be considered material.
